description: This source file defines the `ChatMarkdownPreprocessor` enum in Swift, providing functionality to process and clean Markdown messages in chat contexts. It includes methods for stripping envelope headers, message ID hints, inbound context blocks, timestamps, and processing inline images embedded via data URLs. The file also defines associated data structures like `InlineImage` and `Result`.

classes.name: InlineImage
classes.description: A structure representing an inline image extracted from markdown, with a label and optional image data.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: A structure encapsulating the cleaned markdown string and associated inline images after preprocessing.

methods.name: preprocess
methods.description: Main static method to process raw markdown text, removing envelope headers, message ID hints, context blocks, timestamps, and extracting inline images.

methods.name: inlineImage
methods.description: Creates an InlineImage object if the source string contains valid base64-encoded image data.

methods.name: fallbackImageLabel
methods.description: Provides a fallback label for images when no label is specified.

methods.name: stripEnvelope
methods.description: Removes envelope headers from the raw input if they resemble a recognized envelope format.

methods.name: looksLikeEnvelopeHeader
methods.description: Determines if a header string resembles an envelope header based on date/time patterns or known envelope channels.

methods.name: stripMessageIdHints
methods.description: Removes message ID hint lines from the raw markdown input.

methods.name: stripInboundContextBlocks
methods.description: Removes inbound context headers and fenced JSON blocks from the raw input.

methods.name: shouldStripTrailingUntrustedContext
methods.description: Helper to decide whether to strip trailing untrusted context based on specific patterns.

methods.name: stripPrefixedTimestamps
methods.description: Removes timestamp prefixes from the raw markdown.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes the raw markdown by replacing line endings and collapsing multiple blank lines.
